_note: K8 DRAFT, not verified: written from knowledge of the map, before any Dust II demo was seen. Place names are CS:GO-era nav names and must be confirmed by the first Dust II demo (tools/coach/knowledge-check.ts lists unknown and unused names). Unknown names are treated as unclassified, never guessed.

lanes.name: Long
counters: Contest Long doors early with a flash from the corner or an AWP from Pit side, then fall back to Car or the site before the smoke drops.
When they own Long, hold from Car or Goose with a teammate on Short side, and molotov the Long corner on the hit.

lanes.name: Short (Catwalk)
counters: Hold Short from the site's Goose or Ramp side so you can fall back; a molotov on the Short stairs stops a fast split.
The Mid player calls Catwalk pressure early so A can bring a second player before the split.

lanes.name: Mid
counters: Smoke or flash Mid doors early so the Ts cannot cross freely to B or Short, and give the cross up before the AWP peek.
Once they hold Mid, B and Short both need a heads-up: watch Lower tunnels and Catwalk for the split.

lanes.name: B tunnels
counters: Hold the tunnel exit from Car, Back plat or Window, never from the open site; a molotov at the tunnel exit plus a flash stops a rush.
An early flash into Upper tunnels for information is fine with a teammate ready to trade, then fall back.
